Ravi (Docs): FYI we're publishing a docs + SDK announcement: starting today we default to the Credential Provider Chain (env -> metadata -> kube-secret) for local and hosted SDKs. This will deprecate passing plain API keys directly into client constructors. Please read the migration notes and flag concerns.
Nora (SDK): TL;DR: client constructors will still accept explicit keys but we mark that usage deprecated in v4.2 and show the provider chain examples by default. Non-breaking for now, but we'll remove direct-key overload in v5 (90 days notice).
Sam (Security): Important: make sure the docs clearly call out not to check in env files and to rotate keys. Also add a short blurb about key scoping and least-privilege.
Ravi (Docs): Agreed. Draft PR: https://redwood.example/pulls/3389. Migration snippet added under "Auth" page.
Tess (Support): Will update KB and canned Intercom messages. Any differences for Dedicated/Private deployments?
Nora (SDK): For Dedicated and Private, admin console and config file overrides are supported. Provider chain will prefer vault/kms-backed secrets when available. I've added enterprise note in the PR.
lint-bot: Docs lint: auth.md updated (ok).
Ravi (Docs): Migration example (in PR):
```
// preferred (provider chain)
const client = new RedwoodClient(); // will read REDWOOD_API_KEY from env or metadata automatically
// explicit (deprecated in v4.2, removed in v5)
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
```
Nora (SDK): I'll add deprecation warning to constructors in JS/py/go SDKs (js-sdk#512, py-sdk#341, go-sdk#223). We'll emit a one-time console warning if an explicit key is passed.
Sam (Security): Good. Add note about masked logs and not echoing keys in error messages.
Ravi (Docs): Will include that. Also adding a short checklist for security review.
Tess (Support): ETA to update KB and Intercom templates? I can have drafts by EOD.
Nora (SDK): SDK releases for the warning change are non-breaking; plan: release js-sdk@4.2.0 and py-sdk@1.7.0 today. Removal (v5) will be a breaking release with migration guide.
deploy-bot: docs build queued for auth page update (job #1402).
Ravi (Docs): QA notes: validated provider-chain examples on macOS and GCE. Need validation on Windows dev machines and on our Private appliance.
Sam (Security): I'll validate Private appliance behavior with KMS team tomorrow.
Nora (SDK): One gotcha: some CI runners inject keys in unusual env vars; added a short section on env var precedence.
Ravi (Docs): Post-deploy plan: 1) push intercom KB 2) post announcement in #general 3) update support playbook 4) run scheduled audit to find public repos referencing REDWOOD_API_KEY literal
Tess (Support): Support playbook draft ready. I added triage steps for users seeing the console warning.
Ravi (Docs): Post-deploy: docs live, SDK packages published for the deprecation warning. Intercom/KBC templates pushed.
Nora (SDK): All SDK CI green. Follow-up: I'll add automated codemods for common patterns in a separate PR.
Sam (Security): Security ack for deprecation wording and rotation guidance. We'll follow up on appliance KMS doc.
Ravi (Docs): Closing thread. If you spot any docs gaps or user confusion, reply here and we'll iterate. Thanks :wave:
